description: kdk-lab: container image updates as grouped weekend PRs. See docs/komodo-gitops.md#dependency-updates-renovate. Every image-string change recreates the container on merge.

packageRules.description: Local builds (stacks/*/Dockerfile -> kdk/*:latest): no registry to look up.
Patch + digest updates (incl. the first pinDigest wave): one grouped PR for the internal hosts.
Patch + digest updates for stacks on kdk-dkr-dmz-01: separate group, merged first (dmz-proxy -> identity -> rest).
Majors: one PR per package, only after ticking the box on the Dependency Dashboard.
backup-* stacks use postgres only as the pg_dump client (newer client dumping an older server is supported): majors need no dashboard approval and never mix with the DB-server postgres PR.
Auth / edge components: extra label so they are reviewed with the identity stack in mind.
linuxserver.io tags: <version>[.<build>]-ls<revision>, optional leading v (bazarr).
linuxserver jellyfin: 12.3ubu2604-ls56; the ubuNNNN base is kept as compatibility.
instrumentisto/rsync-ssh tags: alpine<alpine-version>-r<revision>.
SearXNG rolling release: tags are YYYY.M.D-<commit> (several a day, no semver). Year/month/day = major/minor/patch; the commit hash is not compared. Day bumps ride the weekly internal patch group.
NUT: a recreate once shut down kdk-hyp-01. Never a version PR; digest refreshes only, and only on explicit dashboard approval.
NUT digest refreshes: disabled entirely. A NUT recreate once shut down kdk-hyp-01; refresh the digest by hand, on a chosen day, with someone watching (docs/services/nut.md).

Immich database + cache: the tag follows Immich's own release compose (postgres 14-vectorchord, valkey 9); digest refreshes only, never a tag bump here. Scoped to stacks/immich so other valkey users (stacks/searxng) get normal version PRs.
python base images (7 Dockerfiles + 7 one-shot compose jobs) and the CI python-version: stay on a release with wheels for every pinned package; 3.14+ is opened by hand after a test build.
GitHub Actions majors (actions/checkout, actions/setup-python): one grouped PR, no dashboard approval; CI-only, no container is touched.

BookBridge (stacks/reading-sync): weekly upstream releases from one main author; a minor can change the KOSync or ABS-ebook behaviour the kosync-helper relies on, and settings only seed the DB on first boot. Minors and majors wait for a Dependency Dashboard tick and a read of the release notes; patches and digests ride the dmz patch group.
kosync-helper Python deps (stacks/reading-sync/kosync-helper uv.lock): one grouped PR; the helper's pytest suite gates it in the reading-sync workflow.

dashboard-mealplan Python deps (stacks/dashboard/mealplan/requirements.txt): one grouped PR; run the mealplan pytest suite (command in docs/services/dashboard.md) before merging, then check /healthz and the kitchen page after the Komodo redeploy.

wger server + PowerSync (stacks/wger): a wger minor has carried breaking API changes twice in 2026 and can need a new vendored powersync/sync_rules.yaml, so minors and majors wait for a Dependency Dashboard tick; patches and digests stay in the internal group.

postgres DB servers (identity, jellystat, tandoor, wger): all run 18 (wger from its first deploy, 2026-11). A major is still a dump/restore done by hand in an attended window (docs/runbooks/postgres-major-upgrade.md); Renovate may open the PR, which stays behind Dependency Dashboard approval and is merged only mid-window after the 16-style park step.
requires-python follows the Docker base image; Renovate bumped it alone on 2026-11-07 (grocery-planner =3.13 on a python:3.12 image) and the Tue build failed. Bump both by hand together.

The CI python-version in reading-sync.yml has to match kosync-helper's requires-python (==3.12.*) and its Dockerfile FROM; uv cannot run the suite on any other minor. Renovate bumped it alone on 2026-11-11 (#477, 3.12 -> 3.13, test job red), the github-actions twin of the pep621 rule above. Bump all three by hand together.

idrac_exporter 3.0.0 panics on any whole-number env setting (interface conversion uint64/uint in internal/config/env.go, seen 2026-11-11 on kdk-mon-01). Hold below 3 until upstream fixes env parsing or we move settings to a config file.
